title: one performance pass over everything, and no work that grows faster than linear

stages.title: the growth tool
stages.summary: Builds `bun nv scaling`, which runs a program at several sizes and reports how fast its cost grows.

stages.title: the ladders, area by area
stages.summary: Writes a ladder for every area, runs them, and records every problem as a gap owned by this goal.

stages.title: the review
stages.summary: Reads the code of every area for growth problems no ladder shows, and records each one as a gap owned by this goal.

stages.title: the fixes
stages.summary: Fixes every gap owned by this goal at its root, with its ladder kept as the guard.

stages.title: growth becomes a feature proof
stages.summary: Makes every feature's perf proof check its own growth, so a feature added later is checked the moment its bench first runs.

shapes: Feature proofs — an example, an attack, a bench, a `covers:` marker

stages.title: the summary
stages.summary: Writes `docs/perf/performance-pass.md`, a short plain summary for the user, and re-records every stale perf figure.

checks.name: every bench costs the same per operation in every small batch
want: every bench costs the same per operation in every batch

checks.name: every area has a ladder and a review section
want: every area has a ladder and a review section

checks.name: every ladder is within its declared growth
want: every ladder is within its declared growth

checks.name: the perf proof judges a feature's growth
want: a bench whose cost per operation rises as its batches double fails its perf proof
a bench that grows faster than its declared complexity fails its perf proof
a bench with no declared complexity fails its perf proof

checks.name: every bench's iteration count is no larger than its growth check needs
want: every bench's iteration count is no larger than its growth check needs

checks.name: the bench tree's counted work is within its budget
want: the bench tree's counted work is within its budget

checks.name: docs/perf/performance-pass.md has its five sections
argv: const t=require('fs').readFileSync('docs/perf/performance-pass.md','utf8');const m=['## What we found','## What got better','## Decisions for you','## Benches to look at','## What we checked and found fine'].filter(h=>!t.includes(h));if(m.length){console.log('missing: '+m.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('the summary has its five sections')
want: the summary has its five sections

checks.name: the whole roster owes nothing, perf figures and their growth included
want: nothing owed in the whole roster
